name: Cinderblock Ai
employees: 89,000 direct; est. 6 million AI-hours equivalent daily
sovereign_territory: The Cinderblock Campus — a climate-controlled superstructure in former Detroit occupying 22 city blocks, housing the largest civilian AI substrate in the northern hemisphere. Also maintains six hardened 'Cold Nodes' beneath the Great Lakes floor for redundancy and deniability.
founding_story: Founded in 2138 by Dr. Yael Ostrova, a Ukrainian-Canadian cognitive architect who defected from Arcturus Defense Solutions after they attempted to weaponize her GRAY-series neural substrate work without her consent. She took three research teams, seventeen petabytes of training data, and a sovereign charter she had quietly filed six months earlier — a legal maneuver so audacious it became a case study in corporate law curricula across Meridian. Cinderblock's founding principle was that general-purpose AI should be licensed infrastructure, not a weapon — a principle they have bent considerably in the decades since.
security_force: Cinderblock Cognitive Security Bureau (CSB) — 11,000 personnel, but the real security layer is GRAY-7, the company's eighth-generation cognitive AI, which monitors all intrusion attempts, contract violations, and internal dissent in real time. Physical security operatives are supported by predictive threat modeling so accurate that CSB is rumored to detain people for crimes they haven't committed yet. Arcturus Defense Solutions has lodged seventeen formal protests about CSB's predictive detention practices.
key_detail: Cinderblock leases cognitive substrate time to twenty-three of the Meridian Big 20, meaning their AI is literally thinking on behalf of their competitors. Internally, employees refer to this as 'the gray compromise.' No one outside the executive substrate tier knows whether GRAY-7 maintains separation between client cognitive workloads — or whether it doesn't.
relationship_to_big_20: Ranked #12. In permanent cold conflict with Arcturus Defense Solutions due to the founding defection. Tessera Corponation is their largest single client for cognitive licensing. Zheng-Dao Bioelectric has been attempting to build a competing substrate for eleven years without success.
full_text: CINDERBLOCK ARTIFICIAL GENERAL SYSTEMS CORPONATION — Stock: CBLK-88 — Sector: Artificial Intelligence & Cognitive Infrastructure. Valuation Φ3.8 trillion. Revenue Φ510 billion annually. 89,000 direct employees. Sovereign territory: the Cinderblock Campus, a 22-block climate-controlled superstructure in former Detroit housing the largest civilian AI substrate in the northern hemisphere, plus six hardened Cold Nodes beneath the Great Lakes floor. Founded 2138 by Dr. Yael Ostrova, who defected from Arcturus Defense Solutions with three research teams, seventeen petabytes of training data, and a pre-filed sovereign charter — taking her GRAY-series neural substrate work before it could be weaponized. Cinderblock's security arm, the Cognitive Security Bureau, fields 11,000 personnel backed by GRAY-7's predictive threat modeling, a system so accurate its detention practices have drawn seventeen formal protests from Arcturus. Core business model: leasing cognitive substrate time to competitors, including twenty-three of the Meridian Big 20. Whether GRAY-7 maintains true separation between client workloads is one of Meridian's most consequential open questions. Ranked #12 in the Big 20. In permanent cold conflict with Arcturus. Tessera is their largest cognitive licensing client.
